Sēo hǣtste stōƿ on þissum systeme. Þæs Vulcones bend tō Juno macaþ þisne andƿlitan sƿā hātne sƿā ǣnig miht bēon būton his fædersteorran hreppan. Nis nā gamen þæt se grund is fȳres flōd.
Þā miclan þryccas on Vulco macaþ fȳrflōƿas rinnan of ǣr oþ æfter · þanon cumaþ sume þā mǣstan eorðƿundru on eallum systeme.
Þæt bēon gebunden tō steorran macaþ ǣnne andƿlitan ƿōdlicne hātne and þone ōþerne ƿōdlicne cealdne. Ne geseah þēos ginung lēoht Juno on ealdum ǣrum.
Ne fintst þū Cerberus on þissum dene · ac Helles Geat mæg þē atēoƿan hƿylc hit biþ tō scēaƿienne heortan tungoles þurh his hrūsan.
Se mǣsta cƿic fȳrmunt on þissum systeme · sƿīþe hēah and earfoþ tō climbenne · ac gīet earfoþre tō ætberstenne syþþan þū in his clēofan āstīhst.
Þā muntas nēah Hathor Mons ƿurdon of ānum þæs fȳrmuntes berste. Hīe bringaþ ēaþelicran eorðan tō climbenne and gōdne stede tō scēaƿienne and tō smēagenne þīnne nyþerstīg into þǣre clēofan.
Sergeaa hæfþ micelne dǣl his eorðan oferþeahtne mid miclum blæcstānum · þāra þrīe scieppiaþ micelne cynehelm ymbsette mid sumum þāra ƿundorlicostan scēaƿunga.
Þes fȳrmunt is slǣpende þūsende gēara · ac his clēofa is ful nēah hāl. Næfþ hē ƿēnunga nānne fȳrlf oninnan · ac gīet mæg bēon earfoþ tō āstīgenne oþ his botm and hāl eft cuman.
Ān īeg on scēap mōnan on þǣm ecge ānes þāra mǣstena fȳrlaga Sergeaa · helle Hawaii · ymbsett mid fȳrflōƿe and blæcstānum.

Yþa on þǣm andƿlitan · ƿægas of dūste and stāne on muntes micelnesse.

Ān flēot on gearulicre stōƿe tō landienne þīnum fȳrflogþȳstendum þonne þū of DSC āscyndst.
Ǣlces sīþmannes sƿefn · se Sūþpōl. Ne fintst þū Santa Claus hēr · ac his sƿīþe smēðe eorðe mæg bēon gōd for landspēdes gemearcum.
Þǣr þæt ƿealdland mēt þæt ƿēsten · ānlice gestilled fram ānum þāra ƿundorlicostan muntgegaderunga on Droo.
Nīƿ græs · hƿyrfede muntas and beorht Juno · se fullfremesta stede for ǣnigum ganganƿīgendum þe ƿile forƿeorþan.
Stenc þæs gārsecges · þæs ƿæteres hrēam · ceald ƿind þæt cnyst þīnne andƿlitan on þǣre lǣstan īege þæs mǣstan īeglandes on Droo.
Þīn lǣste tīd tō hreppenne fæst eorðan ǣr þū rǣce þā īsbeorgas on ƿeg tō þǣm Sūþpōle · þēah þe hit sȳ eall mid snāƿe oferþeaht.
Man ƿēneþ þæt hit cume of þǣm þe dyde T.T. tō hringienne Droo. Hit gelīcþ þǣm Death Star · ac þēos clēofa ne scēotþ lēohtbēamas. Oþþe dēþ hēo.
Þā þēos Mimas clēofa ƿearþ gesceapen · micel flēogend stān feall eft on Brigo · scieppende rǣƿe hringa ymb hit · þanon cƿōmon micle clifu.
Muntgegaderung oferþeaht mid īse and fenne · and nis hit nā sƿēte īs.
Clif scēaƿiende ofer mōrland sƿā feor sƿā sēo ēage mæg geseon · mid nānum þing būton fȳrstāne and clēofum beforan.
Luna mæg gān of sƿīþe rūgum eorðum tō smēðum landum sƿīþe hrædlice · scieppende ƿundorlice clifu. Hƿīlum mæg þis clif tōberstan · scieppende ēac Simple Rocks Too.
Hƿīlum nis clēofan micelnes gesēne feorran. Binnan ānlice oncnaƿst þū hū lȳtel þū eart. Þis sind þā sōþan 'dēopan' rodorcræftas.
Munt gesceapen æfter micelre cnysse þe lǣfde ānre þāra mǣstena clēofena on þisses mōnan eorðan.
Þes ƿundorlica ūtanrodores stān is oferþeaht mid oxydum · maciende his sƿīþe rūgan andƿlitan habban blēo gelīc blōde.
T.T. atēoƿþ cleare bēcnu þæs þe hit þurhfōr sƿīþe dǣd · forþām his eorðe is dǣlum gemelt · and dǣlas his metalliscan cyrnes sind eallunge undierne.
Munt rihte on ecge þæs mǣstan dene on Cylero · ān þāra ānlǣpestan stōƿa tō nēosienne þā hƿīle þe þū þis seldcūþe landmearc smēast.
Se mǣsta munt on þǣm Juno System ƿæs ǣror fȳrmunt · nū eallunge slǣpende. On his clēofan miht þū būton þencan hū ƿōdlic mægen þes ent hæfde ǣror.
Lȳtel topp on ecge ānes þāra earma þæs Northern Polar Swirl · scēaƿiende rihte into ānum þāra dene þe hit scōp.
Þēah þe hit sȳ seldcūþ · cnyssa magon hƿīlum gelimpan on þǣre ilcan stōƿe. Hēr ān lȳtel steorrastān āclǣnsode þā middelheahnessa þæs middelflōres ānre micelre clēofan.
Se fȳrmunt þe mǣrþ Nebra fruman · þǣr sēo mǣste middellīne mēt his emnendelīne. Lȳtel ac mihtig · ne cymst þū nǣfre of his clēofan gif þū ne beƿǣrst.
Nebra sƿīþe hēah fȳrmuntlic ƿeorc scōp hring fȳrmuntīga · ān þāra betstena stōƿa for landfæstene on þissum mōnan.
Fȳrmunt mid feallendum clēofan þe nū gelīcþ tēapytte. Ic mihte sƿerian þæt ic hit geseah ūpp on þǣm lyfte · grēne sƿā smaragd on þǣm blēƿum · nū ƿundrige ic hƿæðer hit ƿǣre sōþlice þū.
Gif Nebra ƿæteres hǣtu næs genōg þē tō ƿorce · þonne īecþ Litke Dæl eallunge þēostru and grundlēase þryccas þǣrto.
Stoppa on þǣm sīdan þæs mǣstan muntes on Taurus · scēaƿiende into ānum þāra ǣtlestan dene on þǣm Juno System.
Sƿīþe þynne and hēah beorg æt ende þæs lengestan dene · ymbsett mid clifum of eallum healfum būton ingange þæs halses.
Se mǣsta gārsecg methanes on Taurus is ymbsett mid mūþum þe delfaþ into þǣm sǣrime · ful nēah græfende þā miclan beorgmuntas.
Taurus hæfþ micelne dǣl his eorðan oferþeahtne mid methane. Þis īegland is ān þāra ēaþelicostan stōƿa tō ānum þāra mǣstena lāca.

Se Fizzlebottom mægþ is cūþ for heora ƿelum. Algernon hæfþ gecoren tō besettanne micel on Nīƿum Rodore · ƿeorpende feoh tō nīƿum frumƿeorcum tō scēaƿienne hū feor hīe gāþ. Þīn ǣrende is tō gefyllenne sume þāra mearcstāna þe hē sette tō ontȳnenne nīƿe cræftas.

Buck Marshall is se burggerēfa Juno Village · lȳtles tūnes on Droo mǣstan muntgegaderunge. Hē hæfþ lang gesōht tō forþian þæs landes rodorcræft · and nū æt nīehstan mōt sum man brūcan þæs ƿeorces þe hē timbrode · forþām gearƿa þē for sumum costnungum.

Þū miht ēac ƿendan betƿeoh eorðspēde and hringspēde. Eorðspēd telleþ þæs tungoles hƿyrft · ac hringspēd ne telleþ. Þonne þū gemearcost ōðer cræft · se þridda ƿīs scēaƿaþ þīne gemǣnan spēde.

Sƿā þū ƿendst ƿīsa · þū gesihst þā grēnan strǣle on þǣm stēorcræfte hƿyrfan. Hit ƿendþ tō þīnum sƿiftnesse ƿīsan tō scēaƿienne hƿǣr forƿeard pīcaþ. Eft · mid sumum gemearcodum · hit scēaƿaþ þā stīerunge þīnes gemǣnan spēdes.

Hū strange þæt nēahlīce dǣlhlȳd forgnīdþ ecga þisses lēgeres on þǣre grundlīcan ƿolcenscēaƿunge (0 tō ~0.6). Næfþ nānne ƿeald on þǣre scēaƿunge of rūme.
Sēo hēahnes þæs ƿolcenlēgeres ofer sǣ · on metrum.
Se geƿritstede (geƿorht fram þǣm tungolƿyrcendum onbregdnessum) of þǣm þes lēger rǣt his þiccnesse. Set tō -1 tō beclysanne þone lēger.
Se geƿritstede for unhƿyrfendre hȳde þe gemanigfealdaþ þiccnesse þāra ƿolcenlēgera · þæt ƿolcnu magon bēon bescīrode tō syndrigum landum. Set tō -1 tō beclysanne.
Hū strange sēo hȳd ƿeldeþ þiccnesse þisses lēgeres (0 = forgīem hȳde · 1 = fullice gehȳded). Brūc lȳtlu ƿeorþ for hēahum ƿolcnum and hēa ƿeorþ for miste.
Sēo hƿyrftsƿiftnes þæs lēgeres on radianum ǣlcre secunde · geīecod tō þǣre tungoles agenre hƿyrfte.

Ƿanaþ þā ƿolcenhȳde be þǣre tungoles stede on his hringƿege for gēarlīcum ƿealde (0 hit beclysþ). Ƿeorþ under nāhte þynniaþ þā ƿolcnu mǣst æt þǣm nēahstan stede tō þǣm fæder (nēahhringe) and lǣst æt þǣm feorran (hēahhringe) · ƿeorþ ofer nāhte dōþ þæt ƿiðerre. Ānlic ƿeldeþ tunglum þe brūcaþ ƿolcenhȳde.
Hū strange þes lēger fylgþ hēahnesse þǣre eorðan · āhebbende hit ofer hēahne grund þæt niþer ƿolcnu ne sticen on hēahre eorðan (0 = smeþe scell · 1 = fullice fylgþ þǣre eorðan).
Sēo þiccnes þæs ƿolcenlēgeres on metrum · sellende him gesīenelice uprihtne gemet þonne man flēogþ þurh hit on þǣre grundlīcan ƿolcenscēaƿunge. Næfþ nānne ƿeald on þǣre scēaƿunge of rūme.
Þæt blēo þāra ƿolcna. Sēo Alpha lād ƿyrcþ sƿā eallgemanigfealdere þiccnesse.
Þæt inbringungƿeorþ þe gemearcaþ hƿilce blēobendas bēoþ brūcende. For lyfttunglum is þis geƿunelīce sēo y-gemearcung on ānum Unit spere.
Tungolonbregdnes þe forþbringeþ blēobendas be ƿeorþe.
Þæt mǣste ƿēnode inbringungƿeorþ. Mid þǣm lǣstan setteþ þis þæt ƿēnode fæc þæs inbringungƿeorþes tō eftgemearcienne hit on þæt fæc fram nāhte tō ānum.
Þæt lǣste ƿēnode inbringungƿeorþ. Brūced mid þǣm mǣstan tō gemearcienne þæt ƿēnode fæc þāra inbringendlicra geƿrita and tō eftgemearcienne hit on þæt fæc fram nāhte tō ānum.
Þæt blēoƿeorþ tō gemengenne on þæt nūƿe blēo.
Inbringung þe mæg bēon · gemearciende ƿeorþ tō brūcenne sƿā fruman Alpha lāde · for þǣre Alpha gemearcodre on þǣm fruman blēo.
Tungolonbregdnes þe gemengþ tƿā blēo ætgædere be ƿeorþe.
Þæt gemangcynn brūced for þǣm endes blēo (þæt nūƿe blēo ǣr þǣm þe þēos onbregdnes is onbrogden). Þis gecīest fǣstlīce þæt ƿeorþ be þǣm þe þæt endes blēo biþ gemanigfealdod.
Þæt gemangcynn brūced for þǣm fruman blēo (gemearcod on þisse onbregdnesse). Þis gecīest fǣstlīce þæt ƿeorþ be þǣm þe þæt fruman blēo biþ gemanigfealdod.
Sēo innan hyrne (on grādum) be strǣle þurh middel þæs pōles.
Þæt ūtlǣdunge ƿeorþ (ǣr hlȳde and eftgemearcunge) þe is brūced lǣdende ūp tō and ymbe þā innan hyrne.
Sēo ūtan hyrne (on grādum) be strǣle þurh middel þæs pōles.
Þæt ūtlǣdunge ƿeorþ (ǣr hlȳde and eftgemearcunge) þe is brūced æt þǣre ūtan hyrne and beȳondan.
Þæt inbringungƿeorþ þe bringþ hlȳde tō þǣre pōlhættehȳde.
Gif ontȳned · biþ sēo līnen eftgemearcung geclammod on fæce fram nāhte tō ānum. Gif beclysed · magon ūtlǣdunge ƿeorþ oferstīgan þæt fæc fram nāhte tō ānum.
Þæt mǣste ƿeorþ brūced tō eftgemearcienne þæt ūtlǣdunge ƿeorþ on fæce fram nāhte tō ānum.
Þæt lǣste ƿeorþ brūced tō eftgemearcienne þæt ūtlǣdunge ƿeorþ on fæce fram nāhte tō ānum.
Sēo hlȳdstrengþu þe is brūced lǣdende ūp tō and ymbe þā innan hyrne.
Sēo hlȳdstrengþu þe is brūced æt þǣre ūtan hyrne and beȳondan.
Þis bringþ ēaþne ƿeg tō hrædlīce beclysanne pytgang · þe mæg bēon brūclic on forþƿeardunge and fandunge.
Sēo gelomnes þǣre hlȳde þe ƿyrcþ þā pytas. Þȳ hīerre sēo gelomnes · þȳ lǣssan and māran þā pytas ƿeorþaþ.
Sēo mǣste dēopnes þæs pytes on metrum. Þis gelimpeþ þonne sēo pytscieppungebīg telleþ tō -1 on þǣm y-ǣxe.

Þæt ƿeorþ brūced tō līnelīce betƿeoxian þā pytscieppungehlȳde betƿeox inbringungum 'A' and 'B'. Æt 0 · ānlic inbringung 'A' bringþ hlȳde tō þǣm pytscieppungum. Æt 1 · ānlic inbringung 'B' is brūced. Ǣnig ƿeorþ betƿeox 0 and 1 betƿeoxiaþ betƿeox þǣm tƿǣm.
Þæt ānfeald ƿeorþ brūced tō stemmenne strengþe þǣre pytscieppungehlȳde ǣr þǣm þe hēo is onbrogden.
Sēo gelimplicnes on þǣre pythlȳde. Lǣs gelimplicnes mǣnþ gelīcra (and māran) pytas · ac hīe bēoþ mā grīdlīce on endebyrdnesse.
Sēo hƿyrfthyrne onbrogden tō þǣm inbringungstede brūced tō fandienne pythstedas and micelnessa. Hƿīlum helpþ hit lȳtel tō stemmenne þonne manige gangas ƿillaþ hīepian pytas ofer ōþrum.

Se ǣx þǣre hƿyrfthyrne onbrogden tō þǣm inbringungstede brūced tō fandienne pythstedas and micelnessa. Hƿīlum helpþ hit lȳtel tō stemmenne þā hƿyrfte þonne manige gangas ƿillaþ hīepian pytas ofer ōþrum.
Þæt sǣdƿeorþ brūced for þǣre celllīcan hlȳde þe ƿyrcþ pythstedas and micelnessa.

Sēo bīg þe pytas gelīciaþ. Geƿunelīce gemearcod betƿeox (0,-1) and (1,0). Sēo x-ǣx is feorness fram pytes middles · sēo y-ǣx is pytdēopnes. Sēo ƿynstre healf · onginnende æt 0 · is pytes middel · sēo sƿiþre healf · geƿunelīce endiende æt 1 · is ende þāra pytbenda. Se botm · onginnende æt -1 · is sēo dēopeste dǣl · sēo ūphealf · endiende æt 0 · is þæs tungoles geƿunelīce eorðe.
Sēo gelomnes þǣre hlȳde þe ƿyrcþ pythstedas and micelnessa. Þȳ hīerre sēo gelomnes · þȳ lǣssan and māran þā pytas ƿeorþaþ.

Þā inbringendlican geƿritu þe · gif brūced · magon behȳdian þā pytas þe þēos onbregdnes ƿyrcþ. Geƿunelīce ƿeorþ betƿeox nāhte and ānum · þǣr ān mǣnþ fullstrange unhȳdode pytas and nāht mǣnþ þæt þēos onbregdnes ne ƿendeþ nāht.
Sēo ūphebbung onbrogden tō þǣre pythstedehlȳde. Þis is brūced tō forƿarnienne sēamas betƿeox pytum.

Sēo strengþu þǣre pytscieppungehlȳde. Þēos hlȳd īecþ tōdālnesse tō pytscieppungum þæt hīe ne bēon fulfremede hringlīce. Sēo pytscieppungehlȳd is sƿīþe gesetendlic · and þis ƿeorþ bringþ ēaþne ƿeg tō stemmenne hire endelīce strengþe.

Þæt rīm pytganga tō fremmenne. Pytgangas sind dȳre · for þǣm brūc hīe lȳtlīce · hƿæðere · manige pytgangas sind cēapran þonne sƿā fela āngangpyt onbregdnessa for gelīcum ƿealde. Pytas innan ānum gange ne magon oferlappian · ac pytas on syndrigum gangum magon.
Tungolonbregdnes þe ƿyrcþ pytas on eorðan.

Þæt ūtlǣdunge geƿritu þe · gif brūced · healdaþ þā gesamnodan pythēahneshlȳde of eallum gangum. Gemanigfealdod be þǣre pytmǣstdēopnesse and þǣre endelīcan pytstrengþe · hit giefþ þā endelīcan hēahnesstemminge þe þēos onbregdnes onbringeþ. Nis hit nā ǣfre brūclic · ac hit mæg bēon. For bysne · mid āngangpytum · mæg þis ƿeorþ gemearcian hƿǣr pytas sind · þæt þū miht hit fēdan on līfstōƿonbregdnesse tō ƿyrcenne līfstōƿa innan and būtan pytum.
Þā rēadan · grēnan and blǣƿenan blēoƿeorþ (0 tō 1) tō īecanne tō þǣm eorðanblēo þonne se pyt āþenþ ofer þæs tungoles eorðe. Brūclic tō īecanne lȳtel blēotōdālnesse tō þǣm pytbendum.
Þā rēadan · grēnan and blǣƿenan blēoƿeorþ (0 tō 1) tō āteonne fram þǣm eorðanblēo þonne hit gerǣcþ þāra pyta lǣstan hēahnesse. Brūclic tō īecanne lȳtel blēotōdālnesse tō þǣm dēopum pytmiddlum.

Þā forman pytscieppunge hlȳdinbringendlican geƿritu. Ǣlc pytgang mæg cēosan ƿeorþ be þǣm þe þēos hlȳdinbringung and sēo ōþer sind līnelīce betƿeoxode tō ƿyrcenne þæs ganges pytscieppungehlȳdƿeorþ. Þis īecþ tōdālnesse þæt pytas ne eall bēon fulfremede hringas. Lǣssu gelomnes hlȳd (ƿið pytsmicelnesse) mæg ƿyrcan sumsƿīþe ƿundorlice eorðe būtan pytlīcnesse.

Sēo ōþer pytscieppunge hlȳdinbringung. Ǣlc pytgang cēoseþ ƿeorþ brūced tō līnelīce betƿeoxian þisse hlȳdinbringunge and þǣre ōþerre tō ƿyrcenne þæs ganges pytscieppungehlȳde. Þēos hlȳd īecþ tōdālnesse þæt pytas ne eall bēon fulfremede hringas. Lǣssu gelomnes hlȳd (ƿið pytsmicelnesse) mæg ƿyrcan sumsƿīþe ƿundorlice eorðe būtan pytlīcnesse.

Sēo frumsette bīg þe pytas gelīciaþ. Syndrige gangas magon oferƿealdan þis · gangas būtan selflicre bīge feallaþ eft tō hire. Geƿunelīce gemearcod betƿeox (0,-1) and (1,0). Sēo x-ǣx is feorness fram pytes middles · sēo y-ǣx is pytdēopnes. Sēo ƿynstre healf · onginnende æt 0 · is pytes middel · sēo sƿiþre healf · geƿunelīce endiende æt 1 · is ende þāra pytbenda. Se botm · onginnende æt -1 · is sēo dēopeste dǣl · sēo ūphealf · endiende æt 0 · is þæs tungoles geƿunelīce eorðe.
Hræd tungolonbregdnes þe ƿyrcþ pytas on eorðan.
Ūtlǣdunge geƿritu þe magon bēon · healdaþ þā lǣstan hlȳdūtlǣdunge brūced for hēahnesse þāra pyta.
Forƿarnaþ þæt þæt sǣd ƿeorþe gelimplicod þonne man cnyllþ þone gelimplicungcnæpp.
Þā rēadan · grēnan and blǣƿenan blēoƿeorþ (geƿunelīce 0 tō 1) tō īecanne tō þǣm eorðanblēo þonne se pyt ārīst ofer þæs tungoles eorðe. Brūclic tō īecanne lȳtel blēotōdālnesse tō pytbendum.

Þā rēadan · grēnan and blǣƿenan blēoƿeorþ (geƿunelīce 0 tō 1) tō āteonne fram þǣm eorðanblēo þonne hit gerǣcþ þāra pyta lǣstan hēahnesse. Brūclic tō īecanne lȳtel blēotōdālnesse tō þǣm dēopum pytmiddlum.
Lǣt manige unbeclyside hlȳde dǣlas begietan þæt ilce sǣd þonne man cnyllþ þone gelimplicungcnæpp.
Tungolonbregdnes þe rǣt geƿritu of syxƿebbe for þǣm heofonlīcan līchaman and healdaþ ūtlǣdunge ƿeorþ be þǣm geƿritum. Þæt syxƿebb sceal bēon on sīdlīcum gemete (X+, X-, Y+, Y-, Z+, Z-).

Sēo betƿeoxscyting brūced þonne man fandaþ þā ƿebbgeƿritu. Bilinear sceal bēon micle hrædre. Bicubic sceal bēon smeþre · ac ne biþ hit nā ǣfre betra tō scēaƿienne þonne Bilinear · for þǣm þe sēo scēaƿung ƿunaþ hefiglīce on þǣre ƿebbinnunge and scēarpnesse. Gebīd mid Bilinear for hrædnesse būtan Bicubic giefe micle betran gesihene.
Se blēostīg brūced on tungolƿeorcstōƿe þonne man brȳcþ byrste on þissum syxƿebbe.
Þæt syxƿebbes scēaƿungnama geþēoded ƿið þās onbregdnesse (gif ǣnig). Þis is þearf tō brūcenne þone byrsteūtflyht mid þisse syxƿebbonbregdnesse.
Þæt ūtlǣdunge ƿeorþ is līnelīce betƿeoxod betƿeox þǣm lǣstan and mǣstan ƿeorþum be þǣm pīxelƿeorþe þāra ƿebbgeƿrita. Þis setteþ ēac þæt mǣste ƿeorþ þāra frumgeƿrita þonne man ƿyrcþ frumset syxƿebb.
Þæt ūtlǣdunge ƿeorþ is līnelīce betƿeoxod betƿeox þǣm lǣstan and mǣstan ƿeorþe be þǣm pīxelƿeorþe þāra ƿebbgeƿrita. Þis gemearcaþ ēac þæt lǣste ƿeorþ þāra frumgeƿrita þonne man ƿyrcþ frumset syxƿebb.

Þā bits ǣlces pīxeles brūced on rinnendum tīde tō gemearcienne þā ƿebbgeƿritu. Ƿeorþ 32 mæg bēon lȳtelīce cræftlīcor on þǣm CPU · ac brȳcþ micle māran gemynd on rinnendum tīde · sƿīþost for miclum ƿebbum. Hit is gerǣd tō lǣtenne þis æt 8 bits ǣlces pīxeles.
Sēo ƿebblād of þǣre þe ƿeorþ sculon bēon brūced for þissum ƿebbum.
Þæt fandblēo brūced tō gemearcienne þæt X-under-nāhte nebb þæs syxƿebbes.
Þæt fandblēo brūced tō gemearcienne þæt X-ofer-nāhte nebb þæs syxƿebbes.
Þæt fandblēo brūced tō gemearcienne þæt Y-under-nāhte nebb þæs syxƿebbes.
Þæt fandblēo brūced tō gemearcienne þæt Y-ofer-nāhte nebb þæs syxƿebbes.
Þæt fandblēo brūced tō gemearcienne þæt Z-under-nāhte nebb þæs syxƿebbes.
Þæt fandblēo brūced tō gemearcienne þæt Z-ofer-nāhte nebb þæs syxƿebbes.
Fandtungolonbregdnes þe gescēaƿlīcaþ syxƿebbes nebbu þæs tungoles.

Þā inbringendlican geƿritu tō gescēaƿlīcienne. Þis ƿeorþ biþ līnelīce betƿeoxod betƿeox þǣm lǣstan and mǣstan ƿeorþum gemearcodum fram þisse onbregdnesse · þonne biþ blēo onbrogden be þǣm gemearcodan stīge.
Fandtungolonbregdnes þe gescēaƿlīcaþ ƿeorþ on þǣre tungoleorðan.
Fandtungolonbregdnes þe gescēaƿlīcaþ þā līfstōƿegeƿritu on þǣre tungoleorðan.
Þæt ƿealdƿendingcynn. Ƿealdƿending stemmeþ þone inbringungstede ǣr þǣm þe hit ƿyrcþ þā sōðan hlȳde · and þus 'ƿendeþ' hīe. Sume cynn brūcaþ ēacen hlȳde tō fremmenne þā ƿendinge.
Sēo betƿeoxscytingƿeg þæs rīceshƿyrftdynes. Līnen is sēo hraþoste and sēo lǣste gōdnes. Fīftafeald is sēo slāƿoste and sēo betoste gōdnes.
Þæt getæl eahtfealda for þǣm rīceshƿyrftdyne.
Sēo X,Y,Z āscēotnes tō settanne on þone inbringungstede ǣr þǣm þe se dynƿeorþ biþ forþbroht for þǣm stede.
Þā euler hyrnan on hyrnum tō ƿendenne þone inbringungstede ǣr þǣm þe se dynƿeorþ biþ forþbroht for þǣm stede.
Þæt sǣdƿeorþ gebrȳced for þǣm rīceshƿyrftdyne.
Sēo mægþ þǣre þrāƿunge (on hyrnum) tō settanne on þā līnan on ānre healfspere.
Sēo ǣx ymbe þā sēo þrāƿung biþ gesett.
Se mægenrīm tō settanne on þā þrāƿungmægþe. Gif þis ƿeaxeþ · hit mæg lǣssian þā þrāƿunge nēah þǣre middellīnan and ƿeaxan þā þrāƿunge nēah þǣm endum.

Hū sēo þrāƿungstrengþu æt giefenum stede biþ gemearcod. Feorness on ǣxe · sēo þrāƿung ƿeaxeþ þonne sēo feorness andlangre ǣxe ƿeaxeþ. Feorness on ǣxe eftƿended · sēo þrāƿung ƿanaþ þonne sēo feorness andlangre ǣxe ƿeaxeþ. Feorness fram ǣxe · sēo þrāƿung ƿeaxeþ þonne sēo feorness fram þǣre ǣxe ƿeaxeþ. Feorness fram ǣxe eftƿended · sēo þrāƿung ƿanaþ þonne sēo feorness fram þǣre ǣxe ƿeaxeþ.
Sēo X,Y,Z micelnes tō settanne on þone inbringungstede ǣr þǣm þe se dynƿeorþ biþ forþbroht for þǣm stede.
Tungolƿendend þe āsmēaþ rīmcƿide mid geƿritƿeorþum tō inbringungum.
Þā geƿritinbringungƿeorþ tō ƿyrcenne sƿā beƿrigennes. Æt 1.0 biþ sēo eorðe eallunga efenod · and āþīnaþ tō þǣre frumlīcan hēahþe æt 0.0.
Tungolƿendend þe efnaþ þā eorðan on dǣle.
Sēo hēahþu on metrum tō þǣre þe sēo eorðe sceal bēon efenod.
Gif hit biþ ontȳned · biþ smēþstæpes ƿeorc gedōn on þǣm inbringungƿeorþe ǣr his brȳcunge sƿā efnungbeƿrigennes.
Þæt inbringunggeƿritƿeorþ þe biþ gebrȳced tō forþbringenne þā hēahþa.
Sēo geƿritūtlǣdung þe hordaþ þā forþbrohtan hēahþgeƿritu.
Tungolƿendend þe forþbringþ hēahþgeƿritu for þǣre tungoleorðan.

Hū sēo geƿritinbringung biþ āƿended tō forþbringenne hēahþūtlǣdunge. Betƿeoxscyt lǣst tō mǣst · sēo hēahþu biþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt fram þǣm lǣstan tō þǣm mǣstan be þǣre inbringunge and hire gemearcodan fæþme. Betƿeoxscyt tō/fram nāhte · sēo hēahþu biþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt fram þǣm lǣstan tō nāhte gif sēo inbringung is under nāhte · oþþe fram nāhte tō þǣm mǣstan gif hēo is ofer nāhte. Ne brȳc þis gif þā lǣstan and mǣstan hēahþa ne oferhrēfaþ nāht.
Þæt mǣste inbringungƿeorþ gebrȳced tō ƿyrcenne þæt fæþm be þǣm þe þæt inbringungƿeorþ biþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt.
Þæt lǣste inbringungƿeorþ gebrȳced tō ƿyrcenne þæt fæþm be þǣm þe þæt inbringungƿeorþ biþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt.
Sēo mǣste hēahþu (on metrum) forþbroht fram þissum ƿendende.
Sēo lǣste hēahþu (on metrum) forþbroht fram þissum ƿendende.
Sēo ūtlǣdung on þǣre tō hordienne þā līfstōƿstrengþe (ƿeorþ betƿeox 0 and 1).
Tungolƿendend þe rǣt strengþe āgenre līfstōƿe in geƿritƿeorþ.
Sēo ūtlǣdung on þǣre tō hordienne þā gegaderodan līfstōƿstrengþe (geƿunelīce ƿeorþ betƿeox 0 and 1).
Tungolƿendend þe rǣt þā gegaderodan strengþe ealra līfstōƿa in geƿritƿeorþ.
Þā geƿritu fram þǣm gemǣnan gonge þe sceoldon bēon gehordod on þǣm līfstōƿsynderlican gonggeƿritlāde.
Tungolƿendend þe rǣt geƿritu fram þǣm gemǣnan gonge in þā andƿeardan gonggeƿritu.
Sēo geƿritūtlǣdung tō hordienne þæt stedefæste ƿeorþ.
Tungolƿendend þe āƿrīt stedefæst ƿeorþ in geƿritfæc.
Þæt stedefæste ƿeorþ tō hordienne on þǣre geƿritūtlǣdunge.
Þā ūtlǣdunggeƿritu tō habbenne strengþe þǣre andƿeardan līfstōƿe (geƿunelīce ƿeorþ betƿeox 0 and 1).
Tungolƿendend þe rǣt strengþe þǣre andƿeardan līfstōƿe in geƿritƿeorþ.
Sēo geƿritūtlǣdung gebrȳced tō hordienne þæt ābædene hēahþƿeorþ (on metrum).
Tungolƿendend þe rǣt þā andƿeardan eorðhēahþe in geƿritfæc.

Þæt cynn hēahþƿeorþes tō underfōnne. Frumset · sēo gemǣne hēahþu on gonge būton līfstōƿe · sēo līfstōƿhēahþu on līfstōƿgonge. Gemǣne hēahþu · sēo gemǣne hēahþu · sƿā hƿæðer sƿā se gong. Līfstōƿhēahþu · sēo līfstōƿhēahþu on līfstōƿgonge · and nimþ þā gemǣnan hēahþe gif hēo biþ gerunnen on gonge būton līfstōƿe. Gegaderod hēahþu · līfstōƿhēahþu and gemǣne hēahþu on līfstōƿgonge · and nimþ þā gemǣnan hēahþe gif hēo biþ gerunnen on gonge būton līfstōƿe.
Gif hit biþ ontȳned · biþ hringrād þæs heofonlīcan līchaman geīeced tō ūtlǣdunge þæs ƿendendes. Þis ne biþ geƿunelīce ontȳned.
Sēo geƿritūtlǣdung gebrȳced tō hordienne þæt X-stedeƿeorþ.
Sēo geƿritūtlǣdung gebrȳced tō hordienne þæt Y-stedeƿeorþ.
Sēo geƿritūtlǣdung gebrȳced tō hordienne þæt Z-stedeƿeorþ.
Tungolƿendend þe rǣt þæt andƿearde hyrnstede in geƿritfæc.
Se hƿyrft on hyrnum ymbe X · Y · and Z ǣxa tō settanne on þone tungol ǣr þǣm þe þā ābædenan stedas bēoþ eftgiefen.
Tungolƿendend þe ƿrixlaþ līfstōƿa betƿeox healfsperum.
Sēo 'A' inbringung tō betƿeoxscytenne. Þæt ƿeorþ biþ betƿeoxscyt fram inbringunge 'A' tō inbringunge 'B'.
Sēo 'B' inbringung tō betƿeoxscytenne. Þæt ƿeorþ biþ betƿeoxscyt fram inbringunge 'A' tō inbringunge 'B'.

Þæt ƿeorþ gebrȳced tō betƿeoxscytenne betƿeox þǣm tƿām inbringungum. Beneoþan þǣm lǣstan inbringungƿeorþe is sēo ūtlǣdung inbringung 'A'. Ofer þǣm mǣstan inbringungƿeorþe is sēo ūtlǣdung inbringung 'B'. Betƿeox þǣm biþ sēo ūtlǣdung betƿeoxscyt be þǣm þe þis ƿeorþ fielþ on þǣm gemearcodan lǣst/mǣst fæþme.
Tungolƿendend þe betƿeoxscyteþ betƿeox tƿām ƿeorþum be dǣle.
Þæt mǣste inbringungƿeorþ gebrȳced tō ƿyrcenne þæt fæþm for þǣre betƿeoxscytingƿeorþinbringunge.
Þæt lǣste inbringungƿeorþ gebrȳced tō ƿyrcenne þæt fæþm for þǣre betƿeoxscytingƿeorþinbringunge.

Se mægenrīm tō þǣm þe þæt betƿeoxscytingƿeorþ biþ āhefen æfter þǣm þe hit biþ eftgemearcod in þæt fæþm 0 tō 1 be þǣm lǣstum/mǣstum inbringungƿeorþum. Ƿeorþ 1 giefþ līne betƿeoxscytinge. Ƿeorþ ofer oþþe under ānum dēþ þā betƿeoxscytinge gān ofer bogan.
Tungolƿendend þe gemearcaþ līfstōƿa gegaderode on efenlīcum legrum.
Tƿifeald līfstōƿ · under nāht and ofer nāht
Tƿifeald līfstōƿ · ofer nāht and tōlaf

Gemearcaþ hū sēo inbringung biþ geƿended tō līfstōƿum. Ān līfstōƿ · þæt inbringungƿeorþ is strengþu þǣre hēafodlīfstōƿe · fram 0% æt 0 tō 100% æt 1. Tƿifeald līfstōƿ · under nāht and ofer nāht · þæt inbringungƿeorþ ætīeƿþ tƿā līfstōƿa. Þǣre hēafodlīfstōƿe strengþu gǣþ fram 0 (0%) tō 1 (100%) · þǣre ōþerre fram 0 (0%) tō -1 (100%). Tƿifeald līfstōƿ · ofer nāht and tōlaf · þæt inbringungƿeorþ ætīeƿþ tƿā līfstōƿa. Þǣre hēafodlīfstōƿe strengþu gǣþ fram 0 (0%) tō 1 (100%) · þǣre ōþerre strengþu is 100% būton þǣre hēafodlīfstōƿe.
Sēo 'A' inbringung tō betƿeoxscytenne. Þæt ƿeorþ biþ betƿeoxscyt fram inbringunge 'A' tō inbringunge 'B'.
Sēo 'B' inbringung tō betƿeoxscytenne. Þæt ƿeorþ biþ betƿeoxscyt fram inbringunge 'A' tō inbringunge 'B'.

Þæt ƿeorþ gebrȳced tō betƿeoxscytenne betƿeox þǣm tƿām inbringungum. Gif þis ƿeorþ is beneoþan þǣm lǣstan inbringungƿeorþe · biþ sēo ūtlǣdung inbringung 'A'. Gif þis ƿeorþ is ofer þǣm mǣstan inbringungƿeorþe · biþ sēo ūtlǣdung inbringung 'B'. Gif þis ƿeorþ is betƿeox þǣm tƿām ƿeorþum · biþ sēo ūtlǣdung līnelīce betƿeoxscyt be þǣm þe þis ƿeorþ fielþ betƿeox nāhte and ānum.
Tungolƿendend þe līnelīce betƿeoxscyteþ ƿeorþ fram fæþme A tō fæþme B · and gemearcaþ hit tō fæþme 0-1.

Sēo cyre dyninbringung gesett on þā līnan. Þæt inbringungƿeorþ biþ gebrȳced sƿā lengþuƿendung on hyrnum · sƿā þæt ƿeorþ 1 āstyrieþ ūtlǣdungstede þǣre līnan be ānre hyrnan. Geƿunelīce cymþ þēos inbringung fram dynƿendende mid strengþe 'x' hyrna.
Þā ūtlǣdunggeƿritu þe ætīeƿaþ þā līnan þe þes ƿendend rīmþ. Þis sceal bēon on fæþme fram nāhte (nā līnan) tō 1 (middel līnan).
Tungolƿendend þe forþbringþ lengþulīnan on þǣre tungoleorðan.
Þæt getæl līnana tō forþbringenne fram þissum ƿendende.
Sēo brādnes þāra līnana on hyrnum forþbroht fram þissum ƿendende.
Se hƿyrft on hyrnum ymbe X · Y · and Z ǣxa tō settanne on þone inbringungstede.
Þæt mægen þæs rīceshƿyrftdynes gesett on þā inbringunge.
Sēo oftnes þæs rīceshƿyrftdynes gesett on þā inbringunge.
Sēo ƿeaxnes gesett on þæt mægen æt ǣlcum eahtfealde þæs rīceshƿyrftdynes gesettes on þā inbringunge.
Sēo tōdālnes gesett on þā oftnesse æt ǣlcum eahtfealde þæs rīceshƿyrftdynes gesettes on þā inbringunge.
Þæt getæl eahtfealda gebrȳced on þǣm rīceshƿyrftdyne gesett on þā inbringunge.
Þæt ūtlǣdunggeƿritƿeorþ þe ætīeƿþ þā endecæppas. Norþendes beƿrigennes gǣþ fram nāhte tō 1 · sūþendes fram 0 tō -1.
Tungolƿendend þe forþbringþ beƿrigennesse for þǣm endecæppedǣlum þæs tungoles.
Tungolƿendend þe efnaþ eorðan hringlīce ymbe ānne stede.
Þæt āfeallunges mægen gebrȳced þonne man betƿeoxscyteþ betƿeox þǣre gemearcodan hēahþe and þǣre frumlīcan hēahþe.

Se innanƿearda hringrād on metrum þǣre eorðan tō efnienne. Eall sēo eorðe binnan þissum hringrāde biþ gesett tō þǣre gemearcodan hēahþe. Sēo hēahþu biþ betƿeoxscyt eft tō unefenre eorðan fram þǣm innan hringrāde tō þǣm ūtan hringrāde.
Sēo brǣdu and sēo lengþu þæs middlestades þǣre hringefnunge.

Se ūtanƿearda hringrād on metrum þǣre eorðan tō efnienne. Eall sēo eorðe begeondan hit ne biþ gedreht fram þissum ƿendende. Sēo hēahþu biþ betƿeoxscyt fram efenodre tō unefenre eorðan betƿeox þǣm innan and ūtan hringrāde.
Brȳc þæt smēþstæpes ƿeorc for āfeallunges mægenbogan. Gif hit biþ gecoren · þonne biþ Āfeallunges mægen forgīemed.
Tungolƿendend þe eftgemearcaþ geƿritƿeorþ mid bogan.
Se boga gebrȳced tō eftgemearcenne þā inbringungƿeorþ. Se X-ǣx ætīeƿþ þā inbringungƿeorþ · and se Y-ǣx gemearcaþ þā ƿeorþ þe hīe bēoþ eftgemearcode tō.
Tungolƿendend þe līnelīce eftgemearcaþ geƿritƿeorþ fram ānum fæþme tō ōþrum.

Þæt mǣste ƿeorþ þæs fæþmes fram þǣm þe ƿeorþ bēoþ eftgemearcod. Inbringungƿeorþ æt oþþe begeondan þis bēoþ eftgemearcod tō 'Tō mǣstum ƿeorþe'. Inbringungƿeorþ betƿeox 'Fram lǣstum ƿeorþe' and þissum bēoþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt betƿeox 'Tō lǣstum ƿeorþe' and 'Tō mǣstum ƿeorþe'.

Þæt lǣste ƿeorþ þæs fæþmes fram þǣm þe ƿeorþ bēoþ eftgemearcod. Inbringungƿeorþ æt oþþe beneoþan þis bēoþ eftgemearcod tō 'Tō lǣstum ƿeorþe'. Inbringungƿeorþ betƿeox þissum and 'Fram mǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt betƿeox 'Tō lǣstum ƿeorþe' and 'Tō mǣstum ƿeorþe'.

Þæt mǣste ƿeorþ þæs fæþmes tō þǣm þe ƿeorþ bēoþ eftgemearcod. Inbringungƿeorþ æt oþþe begeondan 'Fram mǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ eftgemearcod tō þissum. Inbringungƿeorþ betƿeox 'Fram lǣstum ƿeorþe' and 'Fram mǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt betƿeox 'Tō lǣstum ƿeorþe' and þissum.

Þæt lǣste ƿeorþ þæs fæþmes tō þǣm þe ƿeorþ bēoþ eftgemearcod. Inbringungƿeorþ æt oþþe beneoþan 'Fram lǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ eftgemearcod tō þissum. Inbringungƿeorþ betƿeox 'Fram lǣstum ƿeorþe' and 'Fram mǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt betƿeox þissum and 'Tō mǣstum ƿeorþe'.
Tungolƿendend þe līnelīce eftgemearcaþ geƿritƿeorþ mid spegelodum tƿifealdum fæþme.

Þæt mǣste ƿeorþ þæs fæþmes fram þǣm þe ƿeorþ bēoþ eftgemearcod. Inbringungƿeorþ æt oþþe begeondan þis bēoþ eftgemearcod tō 'Tō mǣstum ƿeorþe'. Inbringungƿeorþ betƿeox 'Fram lǣstum ƿeorþe' and þissum bēoþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt betƿeox 'Tō lǣstum ƿeorþe' and 'Tō mǣstum ƿeorþe'. Þās ƿeorþ bēoþ spegelode ymbe nāht þonne sēo inbringung is beneoþan nāhte.

Þæt lǣste ƿeorþ þæs fæþmes fram þǣm þe ƿeorþ bēoþ eftgemearcod. Inbringungƿeorþ æt oþþe beneoþan þis bēoþ eftgemearcod tō 'Tō lǣstum ƿeorþe'. Inbringungƿeorþ betƿeox 'Fram lǣstum ƿeorþe' and 'Fram mǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt betƿeox 'Tō lǣstum ƿeorþe' and 'Tō mǣstum ƿeorþe'. Þās ƿeorþ bēoþ spegelode ymbe nāht þonne sēo inbringung is beneoþan nāhte.

Þæt mǣste ƿeorþ þæs fæþmes tō þǣm þe ƿeorþ bēoþ eftgemearcod. Inbringungƿeorþ æt oþþe begeondan 'Fram mǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ eftgemearcod tō þissum. Inbringungƿeorþ betƿeox 'Fram lǣstum ƿeorþe' and 'Fram mǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt betƿeox 'Tō lǣstum ƿeorþe' and þissum. Þās ƿeorþ bēoþ spegelode ymbe nāht þonne sēo inbringung is beneoþan nāhte.

Þæt lǣste ƿeorþ þæs fæþmes tō þǣm þe ƿeorþ bēoþ eftgemearcod. Inbringungƿeorþ æt oþþe beneoþan 'Fram lǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ eftgemearcod tō þissum. Inbringungƿeorþ betƿeox 'Fram lǣstum ƿeorþe' and 'Fram mǣstum ƿeorþe' bēoþ līnelīce betƿeoxscyt betƿeox þissum and 'Tō mǣstum ƿeorþe'. Þās ƿeorþ bēoþ spegelode ymbe nāht þonne sēo inbringung is beneoþan nāhte.

Gemearcaþ hƿylc geƿritfæc hylt þone ISRU ǣhtes styccemǣlnesfeld (0..1). Geƿyrce þæt ƿeorþ ǣr on þǣm strēame mid þǣm geƿunelīcum dyn · eftgemearcung · gegaderung ƿendendum · þonne cēosþ ǣlcre underlīfstōƿe dynstrengþu slīdere hū micel þǣrof biþ gesett.
Se geƿritfæc þæs ƿeorþ (befæstnod tō 0..1) biþ gebrȳced sƿā ISRU ǣhtes styccemǣlnesfeld. Geƿyrce hit ǣr mid þǣm dyn · eftgemearcung · gegaderung ƿendendum. Lǣt ungesett (-1) for efnum ǣhtum.
Þæt geƿritinbringungƿeorþ þe · mid þǣm līfstōƿfæþmƿeorþum · gemearcaþ þā līfstōƿa tō hƿylcum sēo strengþu þǣre frumlīfstōƿe sceal bēon eftgedēled.
Tungolƿendend þe eftgedǣlþ līfstōƿgemearcu be geƿritƿeorþum.
Þæt geƿritinbringungƿeorþ þe · mid þǣm līfstōƿfæþmƿeorþum · gemearcaþ þā līfstōƿa þe sceoldon bēon gestalde.
Tungolƿendend þe gemearcaþ līfstōƿa be geƿritƿeorþes fæþme.
Tungolƿendend þe gemearcaþ āne underlīfstōƿe for līfstōƿe.
Sēo geƿritinbringung þe hæfþ þā ƿeorþ þe gemearciaþ þā underlīfstōƿa.
Tungolƿendend þe gemearcaþ underlīfstōƿa for līfstōƿe be geƿritƿeorþes fæþme.
Se getæl underlīfstōƿa and heora gegaderode geƿritu gemearcod for þissere līfstōƿe.

Gif hit biþ ontȳned · bēoþ inbringungƿeorþ begeondan þæs lǣstan eorðstæppes dǣles 'Onginnƿeorþ' befæstnod tō þǣm 'Onginnƿeorþe'. Gif hit biþ beclysed · gāþ inbringungƿeorþ ofer þæt lǣste 'Onginnƿeorþ' unbefangene tō þǣre ūtlǣdunge.

Gif hit biþ ontȳned · bēoþ inbringungƿeorþ beneoþan þæs forman eorðstæppes dǣles 'Onginnƿeorþ' befæstnod tō þǣm 'Onginnƿeorþe'. Gif hit biþ beclysed · gāþ inbringungƿeorþ beneoþan þæs forman 'Onginnƿeorþes' unbefangene tō þǣre ūtlǣdunge.
Þæt geƿritinbringungƿeorþ tō āƿendenne tō eorðstæppedum ūtlǣdungƿeorþe. Þis ƿeorþ mæg bēon on ǣnigum fæþme · sƿā lang sƿā þā gecȳðan onginnƿeorþ for ǣlcum dǣle brȳcaþ þæt ilce fæþm.

Þæt hundtēontigoþe dǣl þisses eorðstæppes dǣles þe biþ eallunga efen. Se dǣl streccaþ fram his onginnƿeorþe tō onginnƿeorþe þæs nīehstan dǣles. Þis gemearcaþ þæt hundtēontigoþe dǣl þæs fæþmes þǣr sēo ūtlǣdung biþ symle gesett tō onginnƿeorþe þisses dǣles. Þæt tōlaf is se hliþ tō þǣm nīehstan eorðstæppe.

Se mægenrīm þe gemearcaþ hū þæs eorðstæppes hliþ biþ betƿeoxscyt fram his onginnƿeorþe tō onginnƿeorþe þæs nīehstan dǣles. Ƿeorþ 1 bringþ līne betƿeoxscytinge þæs hliþes fram þissum dǣle tō þǣm nīehstan.
Þæt geƿritinbringungƿeorþ æt þǣm þe þes eorðstæppes dǣl onginþ.
Tungolƿendend gebrȳced tō rǣdenne geƿritu fram ānum andƿlitan hyrnƿebbs and tō āstreccenne hīe ofer þā tungoleorðan.
Tungolƿendend gebrȳced tō rǣdenne geƿritu fram ƿebbe and tō āstreccenne hīe ofer þā tungoleorðan mid brǣdu/lengþu gemearcungum.
Se hyrnƿebbs andƿlita þæs middlestades þæs ƿebbs.

Sēo betƿeoxscyting gebrȳced þonne man bysmode þā ƿebbgeƿritu. Bilinear sceal bēon micclum hraþor. Bicubic sceal bēon smēþre · ac ne biþ symle betra on gesihþe þonne Bilinear · for þǣm þe sēo gesihþ hingaþ sƿīþe on þǣm ƿebbe and his scēarpnesse and ēac on þæs ƿebbs micelnesse on þǣm heofonlīcan līchaman. Heald þē tō Bilinear for hrædnesse · būton Bicubic bebēode micle betran gesihþe.

Þæt mǣste ƿeorþ þe þes ƿebb forþbringþ · geīeced tō ūtlǣdunge þæs ƿendendes for ƿebbdǣle þæs mǣstan ƿeorþes. For bysne · gif þis is 100 and ƿebbdǣlas gāþ fram 0 tō 255 · þonne forþbringþ ƿebbdǣl 0 þæt ƿeorþ 0 · and ƿebbdǣl 102 forþbringþ 40 · and ƿebbdǣl 255 forþbringþ 100.
Se stede þæs middles þæs ƿebbs on þǣm hyrnƿebbs andƿlitan. Gemearcunga sind on ānlicum hyrnƿebbfæce · fram -0.5 tō 0.5.
Se hƿyrft þæs ƿebbs on hyrnum. Beƿitian · būtan stæpmǣlum 90 hyrna hit ne ƿyrcþ.
Sēo micelnes þæs ƿebbs tō þǣm hyrnƿebbs andƿlitan. Gemearcunga sind on ānlicum hyrnƿebbfæce · and micelnes 1 fylleþ eallne þone hyrnƿebbs andƿlitan.

Sēo betƿeoxscyting gebrȳced þonne man bysmode þā ƿebbgeƿritu. Bilinear sceal bēon micclum hraþor. Bicubic sceal bēon smēþre · ac ne biþ symle betra on gesihþe þonne Bilinear · for þǣm þe sēo gesihþ hingaþ sƿīþe on þǣm ƿebbe and his scēarpnesse and ēac on þǣre āstreccedan ƿebbs micelnesse. Heald þē tō Bilinear for hrædnesse · būton Bicubic bebēode micle betran gesihþe.

Geƿunelīce ǣlc eahtfeald gemetiaþ þæs ǣrran eahtfealdes mægen be þǣm 'Ƿeaxnesse'. Gif hit biþ gesett tō handlicum · þonne mæg þæt mægen æt ǣlcum eahtfealde bēon gesett tō āgenum ƿeorþe. Þis is foreƿeard cræft · ne biþ geƿunelīce gerǣd · ac hit mæg bēon sƿīþe nytlic on sumum stedum.

Geƿunelīce ǣlc eahtfeald dynes gemetiaþ þæs ǣrran eahtfealdes oftnesse be þǣre 'Tōdālnesse'. Gif hit biþ gesett tō handlicum · þonne mæg sēo oftnes æt ǣlcum eahtfealde bēon gesett tō āgenum ƿeorþe. Þis is foreƿeard cræft · ne biþ geƿunelīce gerǣd · ac hit mæg bēon sƿīþe nytlic on sumum stedum.

For brocenum dyne · þis set þæt brocencynn. Hīe ǣlc gebǣraþ on mislicum and ƿundorlicum ƿegum. Betst is þæt þū fandige ǣlcne · þæt þū gefēle hƿæt hīe dōþ and hū þā mislican gesetnessa hīe drehtaþ. Hafa gōde ƿyrd.

Gif man brȳcþ brocendyn mid ƿendunge · þis set þæt cynn gebrȳced. Þās ealle gebǣraþ on mislicum and ƿundorlicum ƿegum. Betst is þæt þū fandige ǣlc · þæt þū gefēle hƿæt hīe dōþ and hū þā mislican gesetnessa hīe drehtaþ. Hafa gōde ƿyrd.

Þæt tācn þǣre cyre landscæaƿunge for þissum ƿendende. Gif hit biþ forlǣten ǣmettig · ne mæg þes brūsūtflyht brȳcan þisses ƿendendes tō ƿyrcenne selflice gemēlode landscæaƿunga. Þis sceal bēon syndrig nama binnan þǣm heofonlīcan līchaman þe biþ geƿorht.
Gif hit biþ ontȳned and hyrnƿebb biþ brȳced · þonne biþ se geƿunelīca dyn gegaderod mid þǣm hyrnƿebbdynne. Gif hit is lēas · þonne biþ būtan þæt hyrnƿebbdynƿeorþ eftgiefen.

Gemet hū sƿīþe se selfstēorere andƿyrdþ ƿōhum for þǣre giefenan ǣxe. Þis mæg þurfan bēon gelǣssod for lyftcræftum þe hraþe ƿendaþ · oþþe sƿingunga bēoþ.
Gemet þās gesetnessa tō fīnum ƿendenne hū se selfstēorere stīreþ þone cræft.

Se selfstēorere brȳcþ "PID" stēorere mid þrim dǣlum · Efenmǣte · Gegaderunge · and Ƿendunge. Gemet hīe on flyhte tō findenne betst ƿeorþ (Scēaƿungpanele->Selfstēorere) · þonne set hīe hēr tō gehealdenne mid þǣm cræfte. Se hearde dǣl PID gemetunges is tō stīrienne sƿingunge þonne se cræft is nēah his gemearces. Ƿeorþ sceoldon bēon genōg micel tō forþbringenne þā ƿilnodan andƿyrdnesse būtan sƿingunge · ofer fæþm lyftspēda. Ǣlc ƿeorþ · gif hit is tō hēah · mæg bringan sƿingunge.
Tō onginnenne gemetunge on flyhte · set gegaderunge and ƿendunge tō nāhte. Āhefe efenmǣte oþ þæt þū rǣce þā ƿilnodan andƿyrdnesse mid lǣstum sƿingungum (þū ne mæht hīe eallunga ādīlegian). Āhefe ƿendunge oþ þæt oferscēotung/sƿingung biþ gelǣssod. Īec gegaderunge tō fīxienne ǣnigne þurhƿunigendan ƿōh þā hƿīle þe þū healdest sƿingunge lǣsse. Tæcnung · Ætīeƿ inbringungslīderas tō beƿaciende sƿingunge on inbringungum.
Gebrȳced tō lǣssienne oferscēotunge/sƿingunga · þēah þe tō micel mæg bringan sƿingunge. Cræftas þe hraþe ƿendaþ ne þoliaþ micel ƿendunge būtan sƿingunge.
Fandþ tō efenbētenne þǣr þe se efenmǣte ne genihtsumaþ tō healdanne þæt gemearc. Ne biþ geƿunelīce gerǣd for ƿieltunge.

Þæt hēafodƿeorþ þe gemearcaþ hū sƿīþe se selfstēorere andƿyrdþ ƿōhum. Cræftas mid miclum stēorlæte behofiaþ efenmǣte micclum gelǣssod beneoþan heora mǣstan spēde tō bringenne sƿingunge tō forberendlīcum stæpe.

Gemearcaþ þis sƿā forman bebodhūs cræftes · þæt ƿielt ealle dǣlas būton þǣm þe sind īecede of ǣr ƿorhtre undergegaderunge þe hæfde hire āgen bebodhūs. Gemearcung · ne mæg þæt forma bebodhūs bēon ādrifen.

Gif ontȳned · hƿyrfþ se cræft on scopstōƿe þonne gesceapungcynn āƿent (Lyftcræft oþþe Fȳrfloga). Āblinn þis gif se cræft is ǣr rihte geƿend and him þearf is gesceapungcynn tō āƿendenne. Ne ƿyrceþ þes cyrre on flyhte.

Gemearcaþ hƿæðer þis bebodhūs ƿrīt inbringunga of þǣm ƿeorcsuman hūse þonne þis hūs nis ƿeorcsum.

Sylf ontȳnþ þone dǣl gif hē nis gemearcod tō nānre ƿeorcgegaderunge oþþe stæpe.

You must add some text before you can create a custom expression/instruction.
Custom expressions can combine expressions to return a value, but cannot execute instructions. They're similar to a function in functional programming.
Custom instructions define a sequence of instructions to run when called, but cannot return a value. They are similar to a procedure in imperative programming.

Once created, this definition block is placed in your program so you can define exactly what it returns. A new block is also added to the Custom Expressions panel on the left, which you can use to call/execute this expression in your program.

Once created, this definition block is placed in your program so you can define the exact instructions this custom instruction should execute. A new block also appears in the Custom Instructions panel on the left, which you can use to call this instruction in your program.
